capabilities: Record every pop-up notification with its time
Open the history from a status bar bell, ribbon bell, or command
Filter entries and copy one, all, or none (clear)
Count repeated messages and keep the last text of updating notices
Configure retention count and whether history survives restart
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README lists ports of the same plugin for SiYuan and Logseq, and says it is tested on desktop only, not yet mobile; startup notifications shown before plugins load are missed.
motivation: The author cites a forum request: notifications vanish and on mobile there is no equivalent of digging through the developer console.
problem: Obsidian notifications disappear after a few seconds with no list anywhere, so error or progress messages missed on screen are unrecoverable, especially on mobile.
summary: Captures every pop-up notification from Obsidian and its plugins into a reviewable history list with timestamps, filters and copy actions.
